say:1:1230176001:1.text: Shortly after the dock shut down, I joined the Water Wights with a few other dock workers. With no ships coming through, there was no work for us, and we had to find a way to make a living!
say:1:1230176001:1.source_cn: 封港后不久，我和几个码头干粗活的朋友一起投靠了水鬼帮。...

say:2:1230176002:1.text: But now, I'm the only one who makes it back here. Many of my comrades were blasted into the sea by the Dead Tide Fleet.
say:2:1230176002:1.source_cn: 可现在，回到这个码头的只剩下我。好多兄弟都被死潮舰队一...

say:3:1230176003:1.text: When I left Rustport, I actually looked down on Kawa because he was very indecisive.
say:3:1230176003:1.source_cn: 离开锈锚港的时候，我还有些看不起奇卡瓦，因为他总是这副...

say:4:1230176004:1.text: If you ask me now, I'd rather endure hunger for a while than risk being blown to pieces.
say:4:1230176004:1.source_cn: 可现在看来，即使饿一阵子肚子，也好过脑袋分家。
